scope: Icon-only controls on all ten current routes at desktop width, plus newly changed note/countdown/reorder/collection controls

browserAudit.method: Enumerated visible buttons with SVG and no visible text, checked accessible name and rendered target rectangle.
browserAudit.initialFindings: Only Quick Notes Edit note and Delete note measured below 44 px; each was 44 x 30. Countdown delete was 40 x 30 in a separate targeted check.
browserAudit.afterFix: Quick Notes pin, edit, and delete each measured 44 x 44; countdown delete measured 44 x 44. Pin button updated aria-pressed false to true when clicked, its accessible name changed to Unpin note, and keyboard focus remained on it.
browserAudit.otherRoutes: No other visible unnamed or sub-44px SVG-only button was found on the ten-route desktop pass.

Countdown delete has an item-specific accessible name and shared trash SVG marked aria-hidden.
Category reorder icon-only buttons have explicit accessible names and a minimum 44 x 44 target in customization mode.
Games collection cue retains its visible label and now has a minimum 44px height.
